mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when INDPRO rises > 2% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines > 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST rises > 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, the combination signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declining
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO is declining.
